summary: FASE 1 Cyber-Trio Shift Briefing verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/bako/briefing?lang=it returns 200 with {level:'calmo', stress:0.0, alerts:[], stats:{workers:3,leaders:4,low_stock:0}, lines:[3]} — line 0 who='MikiLab', line 1 who='Mohamed', line 2 who='BakoMix AI'. Gate enforcement OK: 401 without gate cookie, 401 with gate but no admin session, 200 after gate 1985 + admin login. Frontend: after PIN 1985 + login admin@mikilab.de/Mikilab2026!, overlay data-testid=shift-briefing auto-opens once/day (mikilab_briefing_day localStorage flag). All 3 avatars render (briefing-avatar-0/1/2) and light up in sequence (avatar 0 highlighted at t=0, line0='Welcome, Capo. Plant status calmo. 3 staff on shift...'; at t~5s line advances to next avatar's text 'No alerts: ovens, stock and hours all within parameters...'). briefing-line updates. Plant-status line with level visible ('PLANT STATUS: CALMO · 3 OP · 4 LINES · 0 LOW STOCK'). briefing-close (X) closes overlay. briefing-open header button re-opens it. briefing-start ('Enter the console'/'Entra nella plancia') also closes it. Regression: after close, panel-autoplan visible at top (y=352) and panel-compliance at bottom (y=1580) — order correct. Names MikiLab / Mohamed / BakoMix AI all rendered correctly. Note: UI language switcher was EN during test, so briefing rendered English strings (translated via tri helper), but backend /lang=it returns Italian lines as required. No crashes, no console errors related to briefing.
critical_code_review_comments: ShiftBriefing.jsx line 25 catches TTS errors silently — acceptable since audio is optional.
Briefing auto-open key mikilab_briefing_day is date-based; consider clearing on logout to avoid stale flag when different admins share a browser.
briefing-close uses <X> icon (no aria-label); minor a11y improvement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Briefing sequence timing is 4800ms per line (3 lines total ~14s). Use localStorage.removeItem('mikilab_briefing_day') before login to force auto-open. UI PIN gate + login flow: PIN keypad shows on cold load, click digits 1,9,8,5 via get_by_role('button',name=D,exact=True). After gate resolves, main page shows 'Sign in' + 'Sign in as Capo'; either opens email/password modal. Briefing overlay is z-90 fixed inset-0 and does not block panel checks after close.
